hero.lede: Social media creator with a computer science background. I script, film and edit, then use AI and automation to make the content convert.

blocks.label: Growth
blocks.body: Took an Instagram account from zero to 12K in six months, built a second audience of 10K on Xiaohongshu, and turned that into 1,750 email subscribers through a funnel I built myself. I plan topics and film for a creator with 7M followers.

blocks.label: Production
blocks.body: Full production from plan to delivery: budgets, schedules, locations, crew and on-set. Premiere Pro and CapCut for edit and grade, Figma for design, Notion for the system behind it. Camera and drone.
